name: Artaxerxes
overview: The Scripture reveals Artaxerxes as a Persian king involved in significant correspondence regarding Jerusalem's rebuilding efforts. Letters written to Artaxerxes, in the Syrian tongue, document opposition to the reconstruction of Jerusalem's walls and foundations, highlighting his role in prohibiting this work. Additionally, Artaxerxes issued decrees both restricting and later supporting the Jews, demonstrating his complex involvement in their restoration during the Persian period.
